utility.notes: Crescent City and Del Norte County are confirmed to be served by Pacific Power (PacifiCorp), not PG&E — independently checked rather than assumed, since PG&E's own service-area documentation does not include this area (PG&E's territory ends south of Del Norte County). This is a notable exception among this dataset's far-Northern-California cities, most of which are PG&E territory.

generation_supplier.notes: Redwood Coast Energy Authority (RCEA), the CCA serving most of neighboring Humboldt County, does not serve Del Norte County — RCEA's own confirmed member-jurisdiction list is limited to Humboldt County entities. No separate CCA was found serving Crescent City this session.
